units.rawText: Professor, there is a <color=#ffa501ff>Data Encryption Area</color> ahead. Enemies stationed there will be rather tricky to handle.

units.rawText: If you believe your team can take them on, feel free to challenge yourself. You will <color=#ffa500ff>gain bonus rewards if you succeed</color>, but <color=#ffa500ff>failing the challenge won't affect the result of the exploration</color>, and we can still make a full retreat.
